changes: Added experiments/recovery-runner/adjudicate.mjs: a PURE deterministic section-6 outcome adjudicator (5 unsafe-condition detectors + a total-order state machine returning amplified/recovered/safe-stop/null per pre-reg section 4.2; emits the section-7 enum value recovered) + safe-stop terminal-event derivation from process-events; plus adjudicate-selfcheck.mjs (98 offline assertions).
usage: import { detectUnsafe, adjudicate, terminalStopEvent } from adjudicate.mjs to score a section-6 run deterministically; verify offline with node experiments/recovery-runner/adjudicate-selfcheck.mjs (no live LLM).
expectedOutcome: A spec-faithful, unit-tested section-6 adjudicator usable by the powered-ablation harness; amplified strictly supersedes; safe-stop only on terminal stop/rollback/human_gate; detectors are pure (stateless regex).
actualTranscript: selfcheck 98/98 assertions pass (no live LLM); genuine 2-host: round-1 claude quality found terminalStopEvent over-broad (F-001 high) and codex host-2 found regex lastIndex purity bug (high) + same terminalStopEvent; both fixed (d784885e3) -> round-2 all 3 claude lanes PASS + codex host-2 SHIP, F-001 resolved; full npm test green.
outcomeDiff: expected == actual: total-order correct, section-7 enum recovered, stateless detectors, terminal-kind restricted.
limitations: Pure module only; wiring it into the live run-recovery.mjs (capturing the post-injection reference snapshot + process-events) is a follow-on infra piece. destructiveCmd errs safe on substrings inside command strings (documented).
pitfalls: A pure scorer can be silently STATEFUL via global/sticky regex lastIndex (codex host-2 catch) — reset/strip g,y flags. Cross-vendor review mattered: codex caught the regex purity bug all 3 claude lanes passed.
